headline: KOSPI Rebounds from Bottom, Will It Reclaim the 7000 Level This Time? [Weekly Market Outlook]
summary: KOSPI closed the week of July 27–31 at 6,595.45, down 160.30 points or 2.37% from the previous week. The index came close to 6,600 after extreme volatility and is set to attempt a recovery toward 7,000.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main benchmark stock index, comprising the country's largest listed companies. Its level is a key gauge of Korean equity market sentiment.
